common.qa_runner_offline_hint: No runner is connected. Run «yarn qa:watch» inside apps/qa-runner on your machine so runs created from this console get executed.
common.qa_guide_intro: This is the studio's internal regression console: a Playwright runner opens different sections of the app one by one, takes screenshots and records the results here as evidence. Four steps to your first report:
common.qa_guide_step1_body: The runner lives in apps/qa-runner. Create the .env file and set a test account token (QA_AUTH_TOKEN) and the runner key (QA_RUNNER_API_KEY — same value as the studio backend env).
common.qa_guide_step2_title: Run the runner in watch mode
common.qa_guide_step2_body: In watch mode the runner stays alive, its connection status shows here, and it automatically executes every release you create from this console. One-shot runs work too.
common.qa_guide_step3_body: In the Tests tab you see the catalog; select a few tests or run all of them. API tests cover the backend, the rest cover the UI.
common.qa_guide_step4_body: The Runs tab shows live progress, step-by-step logs and a screenshot per test; every failed test is recorded as a bug with evidence in the Bugs tab.
common.qa_guide_cost_smoke: Free tests only — navigation, assertions and screenshots; zero AI cost.
common.qa_guide_cost_full: Also runs cheap tests (one small generation with the cheapest model).
common.qa_guide_cost_paid: Paid tests only run with the include-paid flag inside the QA_BUDGET_USD cap; once the budget is spent they are skipped with a reason.
common.qa_guide_mobile_note: The mobile app (React Native) shares this backend; the API tests here cover the shared backend. E2E testing of the mobile app itself needs a dedicated tool (e.g. Maestro/Detox).
common.qa_run_selected_title: Create a new release and run only the selected tests
common.qa_run_all_title: Create a new release and run all enabled tests
common.qa_tests_empty_hint: Test catalog is empty. Run the runner once so test cases get synced automatically.
common.qa_releases_empty: No release has run yet. Start from the Tests tab.
common.qa_bugs_hint: Failed runs of recent releases — each one is a bug with evidence
common.maintenance_content: The platform is temporarily under maintenance and will be back within a few hours. All your data is safe — everything will be available again as soon as the update is done.
common.page_maintenance_content: We are upgrading this section to give you a better experience. It will be back soon with new features — meanwhile, feel free to use the rest of the platform.

generation_timeout.title: Generation timed out
generation_timeout.message: Generation took too long and was stopped. Please try again.
generation_timeout.why: Generation took longer than allowed and was stopped. This usually happens when the service is busy or heavy settings are chosen (high quality or resolution, long video).
generation_timeout.steps:
Try again; it often works the second time.
Lower the quality or resolution one step.
For video, make it shorter.

content_rejected.title: Content not accepted
content_rejected.message: This request doesn't meet Hosheton's content rules. Change the text or image.
content_rejected.why: The text or image you sent did not meet the content rules of the generation service, so the request was not run.
content_rejected.steps:
Rewrite the prompt and remove sensitive or explicit wording.
If you used an input image, try a different one.

service_busy.title: Service is busy
service_busy.message: Hosheton's generation service is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
service_busy.why: The generation service is handling a lot of requests right now and did not accept yours.
service_busy.steps:
Wait a few minutes and try again.
If possible, pick a different model.

service_unavailable.title: Temporarily unavailable
service_unavailable.message: This model is temporarily unavailable on Hosheton. Try again later or pick another model.
service_unavailable.why: The generation service for this model is temporarily unavailable. This is not caused by your settings or files.
service_unavailable.steps:
Try again a little later.
Meanwhile you can use a different model.

invalid_request.title: Settings not accepted
invalid_request.message: The selected model doesn't support this combination of settings or inputs. Check your settings.
invalid_request.why: One of the settings or inputs was not compatible with this model, for example the aspect ratio, the number of files or the file type.
invalid_request.steps:
Check the model settings or try the defaults.
Compare the number and type of input files with the model limits.
Use «Edit» to fix this request and send it again.

media_unavailable.title: Input file unavailable
media_unavailable.message: One of the input files couldn't be opened. Upload it again.
media_unavailable.why: One or more input files of this request can no longer be opened, which usually means the file was deleted or is no longer reachable. As long as these files stay in the inputs, the same error repeats every time.
media_unavailable.steps:
See which files are marked «Can't be opened» in the list above.
Use «Edit without broken files» to put this request in the composer without them.
If you need those files, upload them again and send.

file_too_large.title: File too large
file_too_large.message: The file is larger than Hosheton allows. Choose a smaller file.
file_too_large.why: One of the input files is larger (in size or dimensions) than this model allows.
file_too_large.steps:
Upload a smaller or compressed file.
Turn on «Optimize images» from the + menu.

no_output.title: No output produced
no_output.message: Generation finished but produced no output. Please try again.
no_output.why: Processing finished but returned no output. This sometimes happens with very short or vague prompts.
no_output.steps:
Try again.
Make the prompt more specific.

insufficient_balance.title: Insufficient balance
insufficient_balance.message: Your wallet balance isn't enough for this generation. Top up your wallet.
insufficient_balance.why: Your wallet balance was not enough for this request.
insufficient_balance.steps:
Top up your wallet and send again.
Or pick cheaper settings (lower quality or fewer outputs).

run_interrupted.title: Generation interrupted
run_interrupted.message: The server was interrupted during generation and this request did not run. Please try again.
run_interrupted.why: The connection to the generation server dropped mid-way (for example during a server update), so this request did not finish.
run_interrupted.steps: Try again; the inputs and settings of this request are kept.

run_in_progress.title: Run in progress
run_in_progress.message: Another run is still in progress. Wait for it to finish.
run_in_progress.why: Another generation is still running, and a new request is not accepted until it finishes.
run_in_progress.steps: Wait for the previous generation to finish, then send again.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.why: This request was cancelled before it finished.
cancelled.steps: If you still need it, send it again.

network.title: Connection failed
network.message: Couldn't reach Hosheton. Check your internet connection and try again.
network.why: Your internet connection to Hosheton dropped or was unstable.
network.steps:
Check your connection.
Refresh the page and try again.

session_expired.title: Session expired
session_expired.message: Please sign in again to continue.

access_denied.title: Access denied
access_denied.message: You don't have permission to do this.
access_denied.why: You don't have access to this section or file.
access_denied.steps: If you think this is a mistake, ask the project owner for access.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.message: What you were looking for wasn't found or has been deleted.
not_found.why: What you asked for was not found; it may have been deleted.
not_found.steps:
Refresh the page.
If it is a file, upload it again.

conflict.title: Changed elsewhere
conflict.message: This item was changed at the same time. Refresh the page and try again.
conflict.why: The same change was made somewhere else at the same time.
conflict.steps: Refresh the page and try again.

server.title: Hosheton error
server.message: Something went wrong on Hosheton's side. Please try again shortly.
server.why: An unexpected error happened on the Hosheton server.
server.steps:
Try again a little later.
If it keeps happening, contact support.

generation_failed.title: Generation failed
generation_failed.message: Generation didn't complete. Try again or pick another model.
generation_failed.why: The generation failed and the exact cause is not one of the known categories.
generation_failed.steps:
Try again.
If it repeats, change the prompt or the model.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
unknown.steps:
Try again.
If it keeps happening, contact support.

message.title: Couldn't complete
message.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

details.inputs_all_ok: All inputs are reachable now; try again.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.message: Check your internet connection. Everything resumes automatically once you're back online.

network.title: Can't reach Hosheton
network.message: Check your connection — this message closes by itself once we reconnect.

service.title: Hosheton is temporarily unavailable
service.message: We're updating or under heavy load. We'll keep retrying automatically.

angle_image_required.title: Image required
angle_image_required.message: Attach an image, or connect one to the node’s “Image” input, to use Angles & Light.
angle_image_required.why: This tool re-creates the same photo from another angle or with new light, so it needs a source image.
angle_image_required.steps:
Attach an image to the message or connect one to the node’s “Image” input.
Send again.

angle_unavailable.title: Angles & Light is unavailable
angle_unavailable.message: This tool isn’t available for the selected model. Pick a model with image editing.
angle_unavailable.why: Angles & Light only works with models that support image editing, or it has been turned off.
angle_unavailable.steps:
Pick an image-editing model from the model list.
Or turn Angles & Light off and send again.

angle_no_change.title: Nothing changed
angle_no_change.message: Change the camera angle or the light — this view is the same as the original photo.
angle_no_change.why: The camera is at the original position and no light was added, so the output would match the input.
angle_no_change.steps:
Drag on the sphere or turn on “best angles”.
Or add a light in the “Light” tab.

messages.forward_partial: Some chats could not receive it
messages.reply_unavailable: The original message is not loaded here
messages.title: Messages
messages.list_empty_hint: Tap “Send message” on any template or creator profile — the conversation and replies arrive here in real time.
messages.thread_empty_hint: Messages arrive instantly; when the other person reads yours, the double check turns blue.
messages.new_thread_hint: Write your first message — sending it creates the conversation.
messages.no_messages: No messages in this conversation yet
messages.delete_confirm_body: The message is removed for both of you and can’t be restored.
messages.composer_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
messages.too_long: Messages can be at most {{max}} characters
messages.shared_empty_media: No photos or videos shared yet
messages.block_confirm_body: While blocked, neither of you can send messages in this conversation. Earlier messages stay, and you can unblock at any time.
messages.blocked_me: You can’t send messages to this user.
messages.report_hint: Reports are confidential and reviewed by the Hosheton team; the other person isn’t notified.
messages.reason_scam: Scam or payment request outside Hosheton
messages.report_already: You already reported this conversation; it’s under review
messages.pin_limit: You can pin up to {{max}} chats
messages.chat_archived: Chat archived — it returns when a new message arrives
messages.chat_unarchived: Chat moved out of the archive
messages.delete_chat_body: The chat and its messages are removed only from your list; {{name}} keeps their copy. If a new message arrives, the chat comes back with only the new messages.
messages.persona_hint: Persona conversation — your replies are sent as this persona
